{"acceptable":false, "problems":[
"The pose appears to be standing, but the hips are at the same Y coordinate as the root, suggesting a seated position. This is inconsistent with the request for a seated gardener.",
"The arm_upper_r joint is significantly offset from the shoulders_r joint, creating an unnatural arm angle.",
"The pipe is positioned far outside the frame, and its parent is the hand, which is not a natural connection.",
"The leg_foot_l and leg_foot_r joints are too far apart, creating an unnatural stance.",
"The chair_seat is positioned too high, suggesting the figure is barely seated."
], "corrections":[
"Change pelvis.y to 0.55 to indicate a seated position.",
"Adjust arm_upper_r.x to 0.55 to align the arm more naturally with the shoulder.",
"Reparent the pipe to the chest, and adjust its x coordinate to 0.65, y to 0.45.",
"Reduce the difference in x coordinates between leg_foot_l and leg_foot_r to 0.20.",
"Lower chair_seat.y to 0.75 to indicate a more natural seated position."
]}
